name: Silverwing Eagle
bio: Archetype: Debuff, Extra Action. ⌽ Does a FUA [Lorentz Tracking] on the main target everytime she actively attacks. ⌽ Increases the Ult might and Crit stats of a plant ally's attack based on the number of [Neg Status] (max 4). ⌽ S1 inflicts a debuff that deals damage proportional to 15% of self max HP. ⌽ S2 inflicts [Nasty Wound] to help stack more [Neg Status]s. ⌽ Ult deals more DMG based on [Neg Status] (max 4) and if the Ult breaks Affliatus Guard, follow-up with 1 [Lorentz Tracking].
